D_time_series.yaml::BOCPD.name: BOCPD
D_time_series.yaml::BOCPD.purpose: Bayesian online change-point detection with Student-t predictive likelihood (Adams & MacKay 2007). Run-length posterior plus NIG conjugate prior; score = P(change at t) = R[0], threshold 0.5. Student-t critical for heavy-tailed industrial data (SKAB: 32 percent DR at 13 percent FAR vs BOCPD-Gaussian ~0 percent DR).

benchmark_results.note: CADW-native: recall=1.0 (5/5 cp exact), median_detection_delay=0.0, fit_time=7.3s, RSS=32MB on synthetic_alternating_mean_shifts (n=20000). hazard=1/500, contamination=0.02, burn_in=20; threshold=max(percentile(1-c), 0.5) per Adams & MacKay.

streaming_strategy.fit: rolling posterior: keep recent max_run run-lengths (fix1c).
streaming_strategy.predict: one-step posterior update per new point.

D_time_series.yaml::ETS.name: ETS
D_time_series.yaml::ETS.purpose: Holt-Winters exponential smoothing (additive-error, additive/multiplicative seasonality, damped trend). Classical decomposition init + bounded Nelder-Mead grid search over (alpha, beta, gamma, phi); analytic Gaussian prediction intervals. Reference: Hyndman et al. 2002.

benchmark_results.note: [legacy v0.9.44, migrated v0.9.50]

CADW-native: fit_predict_s=0.18/1.74/17.15 @n=500/5k/50k (seasonal_period=12; scripts/bench_ets.py, .pingis/benches/ets.json). Residual sigma=0.61/0.54/0.52. Peak RSS 4.9/0.1/1.4 MB. Hardware-specific; NOT comparable to external LB. Range 1000x across n - O(n * grid_size) fit; no cross-n comparable fit_time.

D_time_series.yaml::ETS.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; Holt-Winters fit needs full series for classical decomposition + bounded Nelder-Mead over (alpha,beta,gamma,phi). Grid cost O(n*grid_size); not a fit-matrix model.

streaming_strategy.fit: load full series; decomposition + Nelder-Mead grid search (bounded grid).
streaming_strategy.predict: closed-form recurrence + analytic Gaussian prediction intervals.

D_time_series.yaml::AutoETS.name: AutoETS
D_time_series.yaml::AutoETS.purpose: AutoETS: AICc-selected ETS. Evaluates up to 9 configurations (trend N/A/Ad x season N/A/M), skips invalid combos (n<2s for seasonal; y<=0 for multiplicative), picks minimum AICc = n*ln(SSE/n) + 2k + 2k(k+1)/(n-k-1) with k = sigma+alpha+[beta]+ [gamma]+[phi]. Falls back to NaiveForecaster(last) if no config fits. Wraps ETSForecaster; same prediction interval logic.
real_life_examples: Automatic retail demand forecast (no manual model selection)
Batch forecasting where ETS configuration varies per series

benchmark_results.note: CADW-native: MASE=0.4998 on synthetic_seasonal_linear (n=500, seasonal_period=12); 9 configs evaluated, selected ETS(A,A,N) (trend dominates seasonal in this DGP); fit_time 44.1s. WARNING: 44s fit time is slow for n=500 — grid search is O(9 configs * 600 evals * n) Python loop. Backlog item "AutoETS grid search optimization" tracks vectorization / coordinate-descent fix.

D_time_series.yaml::AutoETS.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; AICc selection runs up to 9 ETS fits, each needs full series. Not a fit-matrix model.

streaming_strategy.fit: load full series; <=9 configs, each ETS fit, pick min AICc.
streaming_strategy.predict: delegate to selected ETSForecaster; analytic PI.

D_time_series.yaml::Theta.name: Theta
D_time_series.yaml::Theta.purpose: Theta method (STM variant): STL decomposition -> OLS theta_0 (trend) + SES theta_2 (curvature) -> 0.5/0.5 combine -> reseasonalize. Capability flags: handles_trend=True, handles_seasonality=True. KNOWN LIMITATION: STM underperforms on trend-dominated series (MASE 1.4 vs AutoETS 0.5 on synthetic trend=0.3,season_amp=3) — SES on theta_2 lags behind trend by (1-alpha)/alpha*slope per step; STL fixes decomposition leak but not SES lag. This is the STM baseline; OTM variant (weight optimisation) in backlog. Use for M3-like series where seasonality dominates trend.

benchmark_results.note: CADW-native: fit_predict_s=0.012/0.103/0.981 @n=1k/10k/100k (seasonal_period=12; scripts/bench_theta.py; .pingis/benches/theta.json). alpha=0.65 stable across n; sigma 0.677/0.674/0.680. Peak RSS 4.9/0.6/6.1 MB. Hardware-specific; NOT comparable to external LB. ~40x faster than AutoETS on same DGP (single alpha grid vs 600-eval grid).

D_time_series.yaml::Theta.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; STM on STL requires full-series seasonal decomposition. Not a fit-matrix model.

streaming_strategy.fit: STL decomposition + theta smoothing on full series.
streaming_strategy.predict: extend theta lines, add seasonal component.

D_time_series.yaml::AutoTheta.name: AutoTheta
D_time_series.yaml::AutoTheta.purpose: AutoTheta: CV-selected STM vs OTM. Evaluates 4 candidates (STM/OTM x additive/multiplicative); holdout MASE selection; refits winner on full series. STM = fixed w2=0.5; OTM = weight-optimized (w2, alpha). Additive via STL (y=T+S+R); multiplicative via log-transform + additive STL. Skips multiplicative when y<=0. Never worse than best-of-{STM,OTM} on validation by construction. SOTA-class classical forecaster.
real_life_examples: Automatic forecasting without manual STM/OTM choice
Batch demand forecast with mixed trend/seasonality

benchmark_results.note: CADW-native: M3-like MASE=0.209 (selected OTM_additive; beats AutoETS 0.276 by 24%, AutoTheta 1.4s vs AutoETS 38.6s); trend-dominated MASE=0.296 (selected OTM; beats STM 0.652 2.2x). HONEST LIMITATION: on M3-like, CV-holdout selected OTM but STM generalized slightly better (0.201 vs 0.209); holdout-selection risk documented. K-fold CV is backlog.

fev-bench (anofox-forecast head-to-head, 2025): AutoTheta MASE 1.381 (Nixtla fev auto_theta 1.362) — SOTA-class classical, 1.4% behind Nixtla, 5.9% ahead of AutoETS (1.525). Tier3 export reference value; CADW implementation is a practical OTM/STM hybrid, not exact Nixtla port.

D_time_series.yaml::AutoTheta.tier1_core_exception: Single-series forecasting; n<=1e6 typical; CV-selected STM/OTM needs multiple full-series fits. Not a fit-matrix model.

streaming_strategy.fit: CV over (STM, OTM) on full series, pick best.
